headline: Wall Street Closes Mixed as Nvidia Falls After Record Rally
summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq declined on heavy selling in the technology sector, as investors took some profits after the previous day's gains. Nvidia shares fell after a record rally.
why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark for large US equities, and Nvidia is a leading supplier of AI chips whose share price weighs heavily on tech-sector indexes.
